description: Westland Project Files (G drive) PreToolUse guard — three-rule policy on the Westland share: (1) modify-prompt on any existing file (auto-mode cannot auto-approve); (2) version-controlled types (.xer) hard-denied for in-place changes (force -vN versioning); (3) delete hard-denied (move to _Archive / _to_delete instead). Working artifacts (.html/.md/.json) are allowlisted. Files outside the share are not affected. Runs a single Node script (g-drive-guard.mjs) — no Python/PowerShell dependency, works on the Windows host and in the Cowork Linux sandbox, and fails closed only for share modifications (fails open otherwise). Note: a brief subprocess-window flash on the Windows desktop app is an upstream Claude Code limitation (hooks are not spawned windowless).
